results.title: Every request names the Base version (MES-Version: 0.1)
Job requests use only described inputs and parameters, valid against the descriptor
One submission per task, and following the job doesn't busy-poll
What the client collects, it confirms or releases: no job is left holding
The task completes: the job's output is fetched and the client exits 0
429 busy: waits for Retry-After, then retries and completes
503 no_capacity: waits for Retry-After, then retries and completes
A failed job is reported as a failure; no outputs are fetched and nothing is resubmitted
A job cancelled on the engine is reported, and no outputs are fetched
An unknown error code is handled by its HTTP class: reported, and a 4xx isn't retried
Outputs that are gone (410) are reported, not retried in a loop
